Becker is upset when a patient substitutes his Christian Science faith for medical treatment.

When Adam and Andi borrow money from Joe to help with a cash flow problem, they soon regret it.
Doug (Kevin James) decides an emergency road trip is in order after Spence (Patton Oswalt) learns his ex-girlfriend is getting married in Tennessee.

When the DMV tells Carrie that she has to wear corrective lenses in order to drive, Doug decides that he has finally found the perfect birthday present for her - laser eye surgery.
Becker sees a psychologist and Linda looks for a new job.
During an attempt to quit smoking, John attends a for-kids only pancake breakfast.
Jake gets married to a girl he just met. John buys a faux designer clock as a gift, which gets broken.
John helps a homeless man he discovered is a con artist when he learns the man is ill.
John panics when he has to get an MRI, finally resorting to Valium to get through the claustrophobic test.
John takes Reggies advice to be more sensitive with women. It helps at the office with Margaret, but backfires with a woman he is dating.

Maya's plan for a murder mystery theme party backfire when a grouchy neighbor dies on her doorstep.
Maya's photography teacher asks her to do a nude self-portrait.
